fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (AMAT) fell 30.3% over the past month but showed larger decline than industry peers Lam Research, KLA, ASML; current P/S multiple of 8.52x significantly exceeds industry average of 3.14x.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMAT's leading advanced foundry, DRAM, and advanced packaging technologies (HBM, 3D chiplet stacking) continue to receive steady demand from increased AI demand and capital equipment investment, with advanced packaging revenue expected to grow over 70%.
